title: Terrible toothache
description: A dialogue lesson in which Mr. Croft visits the dentist's office with a terrible toothache and insists on seeing the doctor immediately, even though the nurse says the dentist is busy and suggests he wait till 2 p.m. or this afternoon. Mr. Croft's famous reply 'I can wait, but my toothache can't!' closes the lesson. Includes a fill-in dialogue practice, an appointment-time Q&A exercise, and grammar on past-tense fill-in-the-blank, question-and-answer formation from sentences, and 'must ... I want to ...' sentence construction.
answer_note: Lesson listening question is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (dialogue fill-in) 16 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 77 key (img/key-075-080.jpg). Practice B (when was the appointment) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-5 are suggested model answers. Grammar I (fill in past tense) 10 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 507). Grammar II (ask three questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 (21 answers) are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 507-508). Grammar III (make sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 508). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question.
What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
听录音，然后回答问题。你认为现在是几点钟？你怎么知道的？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.translation: 护士：早上好，克罗夫特先生。

lines.speaker: MR. CROFT
lines.text:
Good morning, nurse.
I want to see the dentist, please.
lines.translation: 克罗夫特先生：早上好，护士。我想见牙科医生。

lines.speaker: MR. CROFT
lines.text:
Yes, it is.
It's very urgent.
I feel awful.
I have a terrible toothache.
lines.translation: 克罗夫特先生：是的，很急。我难受极了，牙痛得要命。

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.text:
Can you come at 10 a.m.
on Monday, April 24th?
lines.translation: 护士：您在4月24日星期一上午10点钟来可以吗？

lines.speaker: MR. CROFT
lines.text: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
lines.translation: 克罗夫特先生：我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.text:
The dentist is very busy
at the moment.
Can you come at 2 p.m.?
lines.translation: 护士：牙科医生这会儿很忙。您下午两点钟来行吗？

lines.speaker: MR. CROFT
lines.text:
That's very late.
Can the dentist see me now?
lines.translation: 克罗夫特先生：那就太晚了。牙科医生现在能给我看一下吗？

lines.speaker: NURSE
lines.text:
I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
Can't you wait till this afternoon?
lines.translation: 护士：恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。您就不能等到今天下午吗？

lines.speaker: MR. CROFT
lines.text: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
lines.translation: 克罗夫特先生：我倒可以等。可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know? 听录音，然后回答问题。你认为现在是几点钟？你怎么知道的？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
questions.answer: It's morning, because the nurse says 'Good morning' to Mr. Croft.

items.title: Can't you wait till this afternoon?
items.text: 这是情态动词的否定疑问句，表示请求。

items.title: a.m. / p.m.
items.text: a.m. 是"上午"，p.m. 是指"下午"。10 a.m.，上午10点，2 p.m.，下午两点。

lesson.text:
参考译文
护士：早上好，克罗夫特先生。
克罗夫特先生：早上好，护士。我想见牙科医生。
护士：您约好了吗？
克罗夫特先生：没有。
护士：急吗？
克罗夫特先生：是的，很急。我难受极了，牙痛得要命。
护士：您在4月24日星期一上午10点钟来可以吗？
克罗夫特先生：我必须现在就见牙科医生，护士。
护士：牙科医生这会儿很忙。您下午两点钟来行吗？
克罗夫特先生：那就太晚了。牙科医生现在能给我看一下吗？
护士：恐怕不能，克罗夫特先生。您就不能等到今天下午吗？
克罗夫特先生：我倒可以等。可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

practice.title: B — When was the appointment?
practice.instruction:
Write answers to the questions — like the example. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
Example: When was John's appointment with the doctor? (11 a.m. / Wednesday, 26th April) → His appointment was at 11 a.m. on Wednesday, 26th April.
practice.translation: Write a past-tense answer for each question using the time cues provided.

questions.prompt: 1. When was John's appointment with the doctor? (11 a.m. / Wednesday, 26th April)
questions.answer: His appointment was at 11 a.m. on Wednesday, 26th April.

questions.prompt: 2. When was your appointment with the dentist? (3.30 p.m. / Friday, 2nd October)
questions.answer: My appointment was at 3.30 p.m. on Friday, 2nd October.

questions.prompt: 3. When was Jill's appointment at the hairdresser's? (5.30 p.m. / Tuesday, 3rd July)
questions.answer: Her appointment was at 5.30 p.m. on Tuesday, 3rd July.

questions.prompt: 4. When was your parents' appointment with your teacher? (6.30 / Thursday, 1st May)
questions.answer: Their appointment was at 6.30 on Thursday, 1st May.

questions.prompt: 5. When was Bob's appointment with his new boss? (8 a.m. / Monday, 4th November)
questions.answer: His appointment was at 8 a.m. on Monday, 4th November.

grammar.title: II. According to the example, ask three questions about each sentence given, then answer the questions. 仿照例句就每个句子提出三个问题，然后逐一回答。
grammar.instruction:
According to the example, ask three questions about each sentence given, then answer the questions. 仿照例句就每个句子提出三个问题，然后逐一回答。

1. Peter bought a watch at Mr. Lee's last month.
What did Peter do? He bought a watch.
Where did he buy it? He bought it at Mr. Lee's.
When did he buy it? He bought it last month.
grammar.translation: For each sentence, write three questions (what/where/when) and their answers, following the example pattern.

grammar.title: III. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction:
Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
Example: finish my homework / watch television → I must finish my homework. I want to watch television.
grammar.translation: Write two sentences for each pair of cues: one with 'must' and one with 'want to'.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=508
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 508).

questions.prompt: 1. finish my homework / watch television
questions.answer: I must finish my homework. I want to watch television.

questions.prompt: 2. buy some writing paper and an envelope / write a letter
questions.answer: I must buy some writing paper and an envelope. I want to write a letter.

questions.prompt: 3. wash my hands / eat my lunch
questions.answer: I must wash my hands. I want to eat my lunch.

questions.prompt: 4. sit down / have a good rest
questions.answer: I must sit down. I want to have a good rest.

questions.prompt: 5. boil some water / have a cup of tea
questions.answer: I must boil some water. I want to have a cup of tea.

questions.prompt: 6. go to the greengrocer's / cook a meal
questions.answer: I must go to the greengrocer's. I want to cook a meal.

questions.prompt: 7. get up early / catch the first bus
questions.answer: I must get up early. I want to catch the first bus.

questions.prompt: 8. talk to the salesman / buy a refrigerator
questions.answer: I must talk to the salesman. I want to buy a refrigerator.
